VMS-DCA-2026  DATA COLLECTION AGREEMENT  -  SCHEDULE 3
HALF-HOURLY DATA FILE SPECIFICATION  (version 3.1, effective 1 September 2026)
Between Varden Metering Services Ltd and Harrowmere Energy Co-operative

3.1  Delivery. One comma-separated file per delivery, named varden-sched3-<client>-<yyyymmdd>.csv, with a header row.
     Deliveries carry two hours of settlement periods before and after the requested range.

3.2  Columns
     MPAN         the supply number, no spaces
     MSN          the meter serial number
     READ_TS_UTC  the UTC date and time at which the half-hour settlement period ENDS, as YYYYMMDDhhmm. Varden's
                  settlement systems use the period-ending convention for every client: the period running from
                  00:00 to 00:30 UTC is stamped 0030, and the last period of a UTC day (23:30 to 24:00) is stamped
                  0000 of the following day.
     AI           active import energy in the period, kWh, three decimals
     RI           reactive import energy in the period, kvarh, three decimals
     FLAG         0 actual, 1 estimated, 2 substituted

3.3  Clocks. All timestamps are UTC. Varden does not convert to local time and does not shift for British Summer Time.
     A local day with a clock change is simply 46 or 50 consecutive UTC periods.

3.4  Validation. Varden validates each period against the meter's cumulative register before delivery and flags any
     estimate or substitution in FLAG.

3.5  Changes to this schedule require 60 days' written notice and a new version number.
file_blobs.VMS-DCA-2026 Schedule 5 - service levels:
VMS-DCA-2026  -  SCHEDULE 5  -  SERVICE LEVELS
5.1 Daily retrieval success 99.0% of meters by 06:00 UTC.  5.2 Monthly delivery by 06:00 UTC on the day after the
requested range ends.  5.3 Data queries answered within two working days.  5.4 Service credits: 2% of the monthly fee
per percentage point below 5.1.  5.5 Meters taken over on 1 September 2026: HMS-1204, HMS-1212, HMS-1229, HMS-1235,
HMS-1248, HMS-1256 (transfer ticket MOPS-1302).
KDS-HRM-2026  -  SCHEDULE 2  -  EXPORT FORMAT
2.1  File: kestrel-hh-delivery-HRM-<run>.csv, comma separated, header row, two hours of margin either side.
2.2  Columns: mpan (supply number, no spaces); msn; ts_utc (UTC START of the half-hour period, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm);
     a_plus and r_plus (the meter's import active and import reactive channel values for the period, three decimals);
     qual (V validated, E estimated).
2.3  Channel values are passed through exactly as the meter registers them. Kestrel applies no scaling, unit
     conversion or substitution. What a channel registers is set when the meter is programmed at commissioning.
2.4  All times UTC; no daylight-saving adjustment.
file_blobs.KDS-HRM-2026 Schedule 4 - polling and va:
KDS-HRM-2026  -  SCHEDULE 4  -  POLLING AND VALIDATION
4.1 Nightly dial at 02:15 UTC over 4G. 4.2 Up to three re-dials. 4.3 Validation: completeness and clock drift only
(drift tolerance 10 s). 4.4 Six meters under contract (Brannagh QM-7), commissioned with the client's field team in
March 2026.
